reasonEn: Christopher Nolan saw 2001 in a cinema as a kid, and Interstellar shares its silent, enormous way of filming space.

reason: Para pengulas membaca semesta batu di Everything Everywhere All at Once sebagai rekonstruksi Dawn of Man dari 2001; Daniels juga menunjuk buku bergambar Sylvester and the Magic Pebble untuk batu-batunya.
reasonEn: Reviewers read the rock universe in Everything Everywhere All at Once as a reconstruction of 2001's Dawn of Man; the Daniels have also pointed to the picture book Sylvester and the Magic Pebble for the rocks.

reason: Semesta tempat Evelyn dan Waymond jadi sepasang kekasih yang diam-diam rindu meminjam romansa nyaris-bertemu bercahaya merah ala Wong Kar-wai.
reasonEn: The universe where Evelyn and Waymond are quiet, longing lovers borrows Wong Kar-wai's red-lit near-miss romance.

reason: Kritikus membandingkan kota Blade Runner yang menjulang dan berlapis dengan Metropolis; Ridley Scott belum tercatat menyebutnya sebagai acuan.
reasonEn: Critics compare Blade Runner's towering, stratified city to Metropolis; Ridley Scott has not been documented naming it as a reference.

reason: C-3PO dimodelkan dari Maria di Metropolis: emas yang sama berkilau, bentuk manusia yang sama dari logam.
reasonEn: C-3PO is modelled on Maria from Metropolis: the same gleaming gold, the same human shape built in metal.

reason: Manga Osamu Tezuka, yang diadaptasi anime ini, terinspirasi oleh materi promosi film Fritz Lang, yang saat itu belum pernah ditonton Tezuka.
reasonEn: Osamu Tezuka's manga, which this anime adapts, was inspired by promotional imagery from Fritz Lang's film, which Tezuka had not yet seen.

reason: Kritikus melihat suasana Blade Runner di Neo-Tokyo Akira yang penuh neon dan sesak.
reasonEn: Critics see Blade Runner's mood in Akira's neon, overcrowded Neo-Tokyo.

reason: Kritikus mencatat Ghost in the Shell live-action menggemakan neon, iklan hologram raksasa, dan cakrawala berkabut Blade Runner.
reasonEn: Critics note that the live-action Ghost in the Shell echoes Blade Runner's neon, giant holographic ads and hazy skyline.

reason: Christopher Nolan mengatakan Blade Runner membentuk cara Gotham dibangun dan difilmkan di Batman Begins, meski ia menilai sulit memisahkan penghormatan yang disengaja dari analisis mengapa film itu berhasil.
reasonEn: Christopher Nolan has said Blade Runner shaped how Gotham was built and shot in Batman Begins, though he calls it hard to separate conscious homage from analysis of why that film worked.

reason: Megakota neon dan anak jalanan bertenaga teknologi berat di Edgerunners mengingatkan pada Akira; penulis Bartosz Sztybor mengaku menonton ulang Akira saat menulis.
reasonEn: Edgerunners' neon megacity and street kids with heavy tech recall Akira; writer Bartosz Sztybor said he rewatched Akira while writing.

reason: Dunia Cyberpunk 2077 yang diadaptasi Edgerunners mengambil neon dan hujan Blade Runner, tampilan yang dilaporkan diambil para pengembang gimnya dari film itu.
reasonEn: The Cyberpunk 2077 world that Edgerunners adapts draws on Blade Runner's neon and rain, a look the game's developers are reported to have taken from the film.

reason: Gareth Edwards menyebut Apocalypse Now dan film Perang Vietnam lain sebagai inspirasi The Creator, yang menempatkan fiksi ilmiah di sawah bergaya Vietnam; kritikus menyebutnya Apocalypse Now dengan robot.
reasonEn: Gareth Edwards has cited Apocalypse Now and other Vietnam War films as inspiration for The Creator, which sets science fiction in Vietnam-style paddy fields; critics describe it as Apocalypse Now with robots.

reason: Kota-kota Asia yang berpendar dan terasa dihuni di The Creator mengingatkan pada tampilan Blade Runner.
reasonEn: The Creator's glowing, lived-in Asian megacities echo Blade Runner's look.

reason: George Lucas mengakui film-film Kurosawa, terutama The Hidden Fortress; kritikus melihat pola sekelompok orang dengan misi dari Seven Samurai bergema di Star Wars.
reasonEn: George Lucas has credited Kurosawa's films, chiefly The Hidden Fortress; critics see the band-on-a-mission shape of Seven Samurai echoed in Star Wars.

reason: Episode Sanctuary menampilkan Mando melatih satu desa melawan perampok, yaitu Seven Samurai di galaksi lain.
reasonEn: The episode Sanctuary has Mando train a village to fend off raiders, which is Seven Samurai in a different galaxy.

reason: Guardians adalah petualangan opera luar angkasa para penyelundup misfit dalam tradisi Star Wars.
reasonEn: Guardians is a space-opera romp of misfit rogues in the Star Wars tradition.

reason: Tokoh Twelve Monkeys masuk ke bioskop yang memutar Vertigo, dan alur wig serta penyamaran bergema dengan kisah obsesi Hitchcock.
reasonEn: Characters in Twelve Monkeys slip into a theatre showing Vertigo, and a wig-and-disguise plot echoes Hitchcock's obsession story.

reason: Kritikus membaca Under the Silver Lake sebagai gema Vertigo dan Rear Window, dengan pengembara yang terobsesi pada perempuan pirang yang hilang di Los Angeles modern; ini satu dari banyak rujukan Hollywood.
reasonEn: Critics read Under the Silver Lake as echoing Vertigo and Rear Window, with a drifter obsessed with a vanished blonde in modern Los Angeles; it is one of many Hollywood nods.

reason: Kritikus sering membandingkan Under the Silver Lake dengan Mulholland Drive: misteri Los Angeles yang pucat terik dengan petunjuk yang terus berlipat. Film ini juga memakai Patrick Fischler dari film Lynch.
reasonEn: Critics often compare Under the Silver Lake to Mulholland Drive for its sun-bleached Los Angeles mystery of multiplying clues, and the film casts Patrick Fischler, who appeared in Lynch's film.

reason: Park Chan-wook mengatakan Vertigo membuatnya ingin jadi pembuat film dan menerima pengaruhnya pada Decision to Leave, meski ia bilang pengaruh itu bekerja tanpa disadari.
reasonEn: Park Chan-wook has said Vertigo made him want to be a filmmaker and accepts its influence on Decision to Leave, though he says it worked on him subconsciously.

reason: Buffalo Bill dan Norman Bates sama-sama berpijak pada pembunuh sungguhan Ed Gein; Buffalo Bill juga disebut gabungan dari pembunuh lain.
reasonEn: Both Buffalo Bill and Norman Bates draw on the real-life killer Ed Gein; Buffalo Bill is also said to be a composite of other killers.

reason: Ti West melukis Pearl dengan angan-angan gadis petani berwarna Technicolor, jawaban yang kelam untuk The Wizard of Oz.
reasonEn: Ti West paints Pearl in Technicolor farm-girl daydreams, a twisted answer to The Wizard of Oz.

reason: Todd Phillips menyebut Taxi Driver dan The King of Comedy karya Scorsese sebagai acuan Joker: pria kesepian yang runtuh di kota yang kotor.
reasonEn: Todd Phillips has cited Scorsese's Taxi Driver and The King of Comedy as models for Joker: a lonely, unraveling man in a filthy city.

reason: Paul Schrader, penulis Taxi Driver, mengatakan First Reformed menengok lagi si penyendiri penulis buku harian itu; strukturnya terutama dari karya Bresson dan Bergman.
reasonEn: Paul Schrader, who wrote Taxi Driver, has said First Reformed revisits its diary-writing loner; the film's structure comes mainly from Bresson's Diary of a Country Priest and Bergman's Winter Light.

reason: Scorsese kembali memakai perangkat GoodFellas: kisah naik-jatuh yang dituturkan tokohnya sendiri, kamera yang tak pernah diam.
reasonEn: Scorsese reaches for the GoodFellas toolbox again: a rise and fall narrated by the man himself, a camera that never stands still.

reason: Belasan aktor GoodFellas muncul di The Sopranos, dan serialnya terang-terangan membawa pengaruh film itu.
reasonEn: A dozen or more GoodFellas actors turned up on The Sopranos, and the show wears the film's influence openly.

reason: Matt Reeves menyebut Chinatown sebagai model kisah detektif noir di The Batman.
reasonEn: Matt Reeves has cited Chinatown as a model for The Batman's noir detective story.

reason: Reeves pernah membahas Taxi Driver saat menggambarkan Bruce Wayne sebagai pria kesepian yang menulis jurnal.
reasonEn: Reeves has talked about Taxi Driver when describing Bruce Wayne as a lonely man writing in a journal.

reason: Kritikus sering membandingkan The Batman dengan Se7en karena hujan yang tak berhenti, pembunuh yang meninggalkan teka-teki, dan suasana detektif yang muram; Matt Reeves sendiri menyebut Zodiac sebagai acuan pembunuhnya.
reasonEn: Critics often compare The Batman to Se7en for its constant rain, a killer who leaves puzzles and its gloomy detective mood; Matt Reeves has named Zodiac as his own killer reference.

reason: Kritikus membaca Bronson sebagai penghormatan untuk A Clockwork Orange: musik klasik di atas kekerasan dan narator yang bicara langsung ke kamera. Nicolas Winding Refn pernah menyebut pemakaian musik Kubrick di film itu.
reasonEn: Critics read Bronson as a tribute to A Clockwork Orange: classical music over violence and a narrator who talks straight to camera. Nicolas Winding Refn has cited Kubrick's use of music in it.

reason: Danny Boyle meminta para pemain Trainspotting menonton A Clockwork Orange, dan tulisan di dinding klub Volcano menggemakan bar Moloko; kritikus juga membandingkan energi anak muda dan kekerasan komiknya.
reasonEn: Danny Boyle had the Trainspotting cast watch A Clockwork Orange, and the Volcano club's wall writing echoes the Moloko bar; critics also compare its young-men energy and darkly comic violence.

reason: Kritikus mencatat utang The Substance pada The Shining; penonton membandingkan klimaks berlumur darahnya dengan banjir lift Overlook, meski tidak ada pernyataan pembuat yang memastikan rujukan itu.
reasonEn: Critics note The Substance's debt to The Shining; viewers compare its blood-soaked finale to the Overlook elevator flood, though no filmmaker statement confirms that specific nod.

reason: Darren Aronofsky mencoba membeli hak remake Perfect Blue (kesepakatan batal) dan menciptakan ulang bidikan bak mandinya di Requiem for a Dream, yang ia sebut penghormatan.
reasonEn: Darren Aronofsky tried to buy the remake rights to Perfect Blue (the deal fell through) and recreated its bathtub shot in Requiem for a Dream, which he called an homage.

reason: Kritikus membandingkan Pi dengan Eraserhead: paranoia hitam putih berbutir dan pikiran yang terjebak dalam mesin. Darren Aronofsky belum tercatat menyebutnya sebagai sumber.
reasonEn: Critics compare Pi to Eraserhead: grainy black-and-white paranoia and a mind trapped in a machine. Darren Aronofsky has not been documented citing it as a source.

reason: Tarantino memutar The Thing untuk para pemainnya dan memakai musik Ennio Morricone yang tak terpakai darinya. Ruangan terkepung salju penuh pembohong menyelesaikan sisanya.
reasonEn: Tarantino screened The Thing for his cast and used unused Ennio Morricone music from it. A snowed-in room full of liars does the rest.

reason: Scary Movie memarodikan I Know What You Did Last Summer, bersama Scream.
reasonEn: Scary Movie spoofs I Know What You Did Last Summer, along with Scream.

reason: Scary Movie 3 membuat lingkaran tanaman dan pengepungan rumah pertanian sendiri sebagai parodi Signs.
reasonEn: Scary Movie 3 stages its own crop circles and farmhouse siege as a spoof of Signs.

reason: Scary Movie 4 memarodikan The Village, ditambah War of the Worlds dan Saw.
reasonEn: Scary Movie 4 spoofs The Village, plus War of the Worlds and Saw.

reason: Barry Jenkins menyebut Wong Kar-wai sebagai pengaruh utama: warna jenuh, kerinduan dalam close-up, cinta yang diceritakan lewat tatapan.
reasonEn: Barry Jenkins has cited Wong Kar-wai as a guiding influence: saturated colour, longing in close-up, love told in glances.

reason: Wim Wenders pengagum berat Ozu, dan tokoh Perfect Days bernama Hirayama, nama yang dipakai Ozu untuk tokoh di beberapa filmnya.
reasonEn: Wim Wenders is a devoted Ozu fan, and the hero of Perfect Days is named Hirayama, a name Ozu used for characters in several films.

reason: Kritikus membandingkan Marriage Story dengan Scenes from a Marriage karya Bergman; Noah Baumbach menyebut close-up Bergman sebagai acuan tetapi menamai Persona sebagai pijakan utamanya.
reasonEn: Critics compare Marriage Story to Bergman's Scenes from a Marriage; Noah Baumbach has cited Bergman's close-ups as a reference but named Persona as his main touchstone.

reason: Damien Chazelle bersandar pada Singin' in the Rain: sepatu tap, romansa tiang lampu, dan nomor tentang bahagia.
reasonEn: Damien Chazelle leans on Singin' in the Rain: tap shoes, a lamp-post romance, and a number about being happy.

reason: Longlegs adalah pengejaran pembunuh berantai dengan agen FBI pemula, sejalan dengan The Silence of the Lambs.
reasonEn: Longlegs is a serial-killer chase with an FBI rookie in the line of The Silence of the Lambs.

reason: Osgood Perkins menyebut Se7en, bersama The Silence of the Lambs, sebagai acuan di antara film pembunuh berantai 90-an, dan kritikus mencatat Longlegs berbagi suasana suramnya.
reasonEn: Osgood Perkins has cited Se7en, alongside The Silence of the Lambs, as a model among 90s serial-killer films, and critics note Longlegs shares its bleak mood.

reason: Zach Cregger menunjuk Magnolia untuk cara Weapons membagi cerita menjadi bab dari sudut pandang berbeda.
reasonEn: Zach Cregger has pointed to Magnolia for the way Weapons splits its story into chapters seen through different characters.

reason: Kritikus melihat Castle in the Sky di dunia bawah tanah Children Who Chase Lost Voices; Makoto Shinkai terbuka mengagumi Ghibli, tetapi gaung yang spesifik ini bacaan para pengulas.
reasonEn: Critics see Castle in the Sky in the underground world of Children Who Chase Lost Voices; Makoto Shinkai has openly admired Ghibli, but the specific echo is a reviewers' reading.

reason: Kritikus melihat Princess Mononoke pada roh penjaga dan hibrida hewan bak dewa di film ini; belum ada pernyataan pembuat yang memastikan penghormatan yang disengaja.
reasonEn: Critics see Princess Mononoke in the film's guardian spirits and god-like animal hybrids; no filmmaker statement confirms a deliberate homage.

reason: Banyak penonton melihat Paprika di lompatan antar-mimpi dan lorong yang melengkung di Inception. Nolan belum mengonfirmasinya sebagai pengaruh.
reasonEn: Many viewers see Paprika in Inception's dream-hopping and bending corridors. Nolan has not confirmed it as an influence.

reason: Kota masa depan Psycho-Pass yang mengilap dan diawasi sering dibandingkan dengan Blade Runner.
reasonEn: Psycho-Pass's glossy, surveilled future city is often compared to Blade Runner.

reason: Sam Esmail mengakui Fight Club sebagai sumber: narator yang tak bisa tidur dan diri keduanya yang ingin membakar sistem.
reasonEn: Sam Esmail has acknowledged Fight Club as a source: a sleepless narrator whose second self wants to burn down the system.

reason: Charlie Brooker menggambarkan Black Mirror sebagai Twilight Zone masa kini: cerita mandiri di mana teknologi menjadi monsternya.
